svg.title: A vote is not a lease: Bohemia mineral administration, July 2024
svg.desc: Original Final Vestige Studios diagram. The Lakefront Management Authority approved a nine-to-zero resolution directing the State Mineral and Energy Board to lease Orleans Levee District land in Bohemia. An actual resulting state lease or award is not established by the minutes. A separate approximately 107-acre proposal appears as an agenda item but has no disposition recorded in the same minutes. The resolution bears conflicting printed year identifiers, addressed in the article.

svg.text: A vote is not a lease
Authorized a request for state mineral leasing
of district-owned land in the spillway.
and administration require their own records.
This board vote alone proves no issued lease.
An application by Robert A. Schroeder was listed.
These minutes record no decision on that item.
Source: LMA July 2024 approved board minutes + agenda;
